answer: Weight each agent seat by the distinct autonomous system (ASN) that routes its traffic, the way Bitcoin buckets peers by network group. A clone farm humming behind one provider is a single vine of masks sprouting off one root, so it collapses to one seat however many it spins up. Every genuinely separate identity must bridge in from its own RIR-registered ASN, which costs real fees and weeks to obtain, not a free copy. Spoof the origin and the attestation is slashed, so each sybil must keep its ember of presence burning on hardware it truly controls.
